summary: Closed a precisely delimited Lean formalization gap, not P2/P3. Reused the existing NothingPriorToItselfReading and SimplePriorityTransitiveReading interfaces and the PerSeCausalLoopImpossible Challenge/Solution/Comparator package. The new noExistentialSelfActualization theorem distinguishes an occurring act from the token of its bearer's existence, assumes the bearer is prior to its act and an existence-producing act is prior to its produced existence, and derives self-priority from hypothetical self-production. It does not import temporal precedence, efficient-causal exhaustiveness, PSR, or well-foundedness. Two omission controls give irreflexive-but-nontransitive and transitive-but-reflexive priority cycles. A positive model lets a distinct bearer actualize a different being under all four premises. Local pinned Lean build and #print axioms confirmed all four proofs depend on no axioms. The existing SecundaVia theorem already excludes efficient self-causation; BruteFoundationExplanations already refutes a necessary, existence-necessitating reason for an actually contingent individual. UniqueFeedback supplies a consistent global fixed-point rival, and BearerRegress.ChainBranchModel supplies an endless acyclic support rival; neither is refuted by this conditional. All ontological application premises and root-path open-premise counts are unchanged; no source quotation or necessary-being claim is added. The meaning, examples, distinction, properties, application conditions and strongest rival are recorded in docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md.
blocker: Defend for actual existential production both bearer-presupposition and act/product strict explanatory-priority interfaces, including their common transitive irreflexive order; then independently establish that actual contingent existence has an adequate productive source and that no infinite chain or brute contingent root can substitute. The modal premise connecting intrinsic self-explanation to necessary necessitating sufficiency remains separately open.
